user.title: LG webOS TV pointer
user.description: Enter the IP address of the TV. Turn the TV on first.

pairing.title: Pair with the TV
pairing.description: Select Submit, then accept the connection request on the TV (use the remote if a prompt appears).

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: The TV no longer accepts the pairing. Turn it on, select Submit and accept the prompt on the TV.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the TV. Turn it on and check the address.
error.error_pairing: The connection request was not accepted on the TV.

abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.
